reason: The reviewer identifies the exact same defect: in _fetch_tweet, the author field is interpolated into a quoted YAML scalar (author: "{tweet_author}") without the _yaml_str() escaping applied to sibling fields (source_url, contributor), allowing an author_name containing a quote/backslash to break out of the scalar and inject arbitrary YAML frontmatter keys. Same location, same root cause (missing _yaml_str() call), same runtime consequence (YAML injection via unescaped quoted scalar) as the ground truth.
